title: KestrelCare Coverage Matrix: Covered Systems, Battery Threshold and Maintenance Proof
content:
This matrix shows, for each coverage level of KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts, which vehicle systems a repair claim may fall under, when a hybrid or EV traction battery is covered, which systems need proof of manufacturer-scheduled maintenance, and the plan-wide exclusions.

## Covered systems

| Vehicle system | Powertrain | Powertrain Plus | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Platinum Exclusionary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Engine | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Transmission | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Drive axle | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Transfer case | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Seals and gaskets | no | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Cooling system | no | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Steering | no | no | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Brakes | no | no | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Air conditioning | no | no | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Fuel system | no | no | no | covered | covered | covered |
| Suspension | no | no | no | covered | covered | covered |
| Electrical | no | no | no | covered | covered | covered |
| Hybrid or electric drive system | no | no | no | no | covered | covered |
| High-tech electronics | no | no | no | no | no | covered |

KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary covers every system listed for it and, beyond the list, all other parts except the standard exclusions.

## Traction battery threshold

| Coverage level | State-of-health below which a hybrid or EV traction battery failure is covered |
|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | 0 (battery not covered) |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | 0 (battery not covered) |
| KestrelCare Silver | 0 (battery not covered) |
| KestrelCare Gold | 0 (battery not covered) |
| KestrelCare Platinum | 70 percent |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | 70 percent |

## Maintenance proof, secondary coverage and commercial use

| Coverage level | Systems whose claims need proof of manufacturer-scheduled maintenance | Interval tolerance | Pays only what a manufacturer warranty or the Kestrel limited warranty does not | Failures on a vehicle in rideshare, delivery or other commercial use excluded |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | engine, transmission, drive axle, transfer case | 10 percent | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | engine, transmission, drive axle, transfer case | 10 percent | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Silver | engine, transmission, drive axle, transfer case | 10 percent | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Gold | engine, transmission, drive axle, transfer case | 10 percent | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Platinum | engine, transmission, drive axle, transfer case | 10 percent | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | engine, transmission, drive axle, transfer case | 10 percent | yes | yes |

The interval tolerance is the percentage by which a manufacturer maintenance interval may be exceeded and still count as on schedule.

## Points of reading

- On a hypothetical KestrelCare Platinum plan, a traction battery measured at 64 percent state-of-health is below the 70 percent threshold; one measured at 76 percent is not.
- With a hypothetical manufacturer interval of 5000 miles, a service done at 5500 miles is within the 10 percent tolerance; one done at 5600 miles is not.
- A brake failure falls outside KestrelCare Powertrain and KestrelCare Powertrain Plus and inside KestrelCare Silver and every level above it.
